newsitem.title: USA: Osicom to give MCI remote access products.
newsitem.headline: Osicom to give MCI remote access products.

text.p: Osicom Technologies Inc said Monday that it will supply MCI Communications Corp with network remote access units to support the long-distance telephone company's contract with the U.S. Postal Service.

The company said MCI's contract had an initial term of five years and two three-year renewal options. It had a guaranteed value of at least $100 million and a potential value of up to $3 billion. Osicom said it was already shipping units under an initial order from MCI to support its Managed Network Services contract with the postal service.
MCI is to provide the postal service an array of telecommunications services and establish and manage a network connecting about 34,000 postal service locations.
Osicom makes transmission, networking, remote access, and connectivity products for use in local area networks, wide area networks, and broadband global networks.
In February, it won a contract to supply Unisys Corp with a complete line of fiber distributed data interface cards. (c) Reuters Limited 1997
